questions.question: What does God promise to raise up for David in Jeremiah 23?
options: A line of priests to serve forever
A righteous Branch, a king who will reign wisely
A new temple far more glorious than the very first
A great army to drive out the enemy
questions.answer: A righteous Branch, a king who will reign wisely

questions.question: What does God condemn in the false prophets of Jeremiah 23?
options: They demand to be paid in full beforehand before they will even speak a single word
They prophesy lies and dreams, leading people astray, though he did not send them
They have wholly abandoned the whole city in its most desperate and darkest hour of need
They speak only the truth but always in obscure riddles that no one at all can understand
questions.answer: They prophesy lies and dreams, leading people astray, though he did not send them

questions.question: Jeremiah 23 says the LORD fills heaven and earth; no one can hide in secret places from him.
I will raise up for David a righteous _____, and he shall reign as king and deal wisely.
Is not my word like _____, declares the LORD, and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?
